faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: What is Zenda and who is it for?
faq.a1: Zenda is Rubiane Joaquim's finance and education app: manage personal and business money, budgets, goals and debts, learn with courses, and use the AI Financial Copilot. Built for anyone who wants clear day-to-day money management in Angola and beyond.
faq.q2: Does Zenda replace a financial advisor?
faq.a2: No. Zenda is an educational and management tool. The AI Copilot gives general guidance based on your data — it is not regulated financial, tax or legal advice. For important decisions, speak to a qualified professional.
faq.q3: How do subscription and payment work?
faq.a3: New accounts get a 7-day free trial. The monthly plan is 10,000 Kz. Pay by bank transfer, upload proof in the app Profile, and our team activates access after review. Loyalty points (when available) can cover part or all of the monthly fee.
faq.q4: Which languages and currencies are supported?
faq.a4: The app is available in Portuguese, English, French and Spanish (Settings → Language). Choose your preferred currency (AOA, USD, EUR, and more); the dashboard and FX converter use updated rates.
faq.q5: Can I manage personal and business finances?
faq.a5: Yes. Personal Finance covers income, expenses, budgets, goals and debts with charts and golden rules (50/30/20 and the 3× rule). Business Finance tracks sales and expenses with profit and SME metrics.
faq.q6: What does the AI Financial Copilot do?
faq.a6: It reviews your financial picture (income, spending, budgets, goals) and answers questions about saving, debt and habits. It can suggest relevant courses. It is educational only — it does not execute transactions or recommend investments.
faq.q7: What is the financial health score?
faq.a7: A 0–100 score on the home screen based on spending vs income, budget adherence, goal progress and active debts. You get a grade (excellent to critical) and tips to improve the month.
faq.q8: How do courses, the app and certificates work?
faq.a8: The Education tab offers courses with videos, materials and per-lesson quizzes; when complete you can track progress and get your certificate in the browser. Download on Google Play (Android), sign in with the same account as the website, and manage subscription in Profile.
